mostWorthwhile.text: Adding the new connective tissue was most worthwhile: it showed how fibroblasts provide support beneath the surface and explained that young tissue is still weak.

leastWorthwhile.text: Making the new surface was clear but felt predictable after the surface slot had already been identified.

surprise.text: The capillary sprout remained connected to its parent vessel and circulation, making the source of the wound's blood supply clear.

arbitrary.text: No action felt particularly arbitrary; the item descriptions and wound slots gave each combination a clear purpose.

continue.text: I would continue for another chapter. The distinction between closing the wound, clearing the clot and the scar continuing to mature made me curious about how the body changes afterward.
